info.title: GT-Online API
info.description: Backend API for GT-Online Consults — project management, task tracking, invoicing, and resource management.

post.description: Authenticate user credentials and return tokens.
Refresh the access token using the refresh token cookie.

get.description: Verify the current session and return user details.
Get the currently authenticated user's profile.

put.description:
Update the currently authenticated user's own profile.

Only full_name, phone, avatar, payout_method, and password can be
changed here. Email, role, status, and payment_rate are admin-only.

delete.description: Allow user to delete their own account.

post.description: ADMIN/SUPERADMIN: Create a new member. ADMIN may only create TASKERs.

get.description: ADMIN/SUPERADMIN: Get all members, sorted by newest first.
ADMIN/SUPERADMIN: Get a specific member by ID.

put.description: ADMIN/SUPERADMIN: Update a member by ID. ADMIN may only touch TASKERs.

delete.description: ADMIN/SUPERADMIN: Delete a member by ID. ADMIN may only delete TASKERs.

get.description: List all projects, sorted by newest first.
Get a specific project by ID.

delete.description:
Deactivate a project (no hard delete): purges its resources
(Cloudinary files + DB rows) and sets status="DEACTIVATED".
Assignments and historical task/payment data are left untouched.

post.description: Assign one or more taskers to a project.

delete.description: Remove a tasker from a project (soft delete — sets status to REMOVED).

get.description: Get all non-removed assignments with project and tasker details.
Get all assignments for a specific project (admin view).

patch.description: Update the status of an assignment.

get.description: Get projects assigned to the current tasker.
Get fellow taskers for a project (must be assigned to view).

post.description: Upload an Excel/CSV file to batch-import task entries for yourself.
Log a single completed task for yourself (the 'as you go' path).

get.description:
The caller's own task entries, including dispute_state — this is where a
tasker sees a task got disputed even if someone else's upload triggered it.

schema.title: Response List My Tasks Api V1 Tasks Mine Get

get.description:
ADMIN/SUPERADMIN: raw duplicate-upload log plus a per-tasker count, for
spotting a tasker repeatedly re-submitting the same task as a pattern.

post.description:
Claim ownership of a disputed task. Either party may claim; the other
party must then confirm via /confirm for it to resolve.

The non-claiming party confirms the task transfers to the claimant.
Requires naming both the task_id and the user being transferred to, to
avoid confirming the wrong thing.

schema.title: Response List My Disputes Api V1 Disputes Mine Get
Response List Disputes Api V1 Disputes Get
Response List Invoices Api V1 Invoices Get

post.description: Upload a file to Cloudinary and save metadata to the database.

get.description:
List resources, optionally filtered by project ID.
TASKER callers only ever see resources for projects they're actively
assigned to; ADMIN/SUPERADMIN see everything.

delete.description: Delete a resource from Cloudinary and the database.

ConfirmDisputeRequest.title: ConfirmDisputeRequest
ConfirmDisputeRequest.description:
Explicit confirmation payload — the non-claiming party must name both the
task and the user the task is being transferred to, so a confirmation
can't be mistaken for a different dispute or a different claimant.

DisputedTaskInfo.title: DisputedTaskInfo
DisputedTaskInfo.description: Included in an import/entry response when a new dispute is raised.

tasker_id.title: Tasker Id
tasker_id.description: Admin/Superadmin only — the tasker to generate the invoice for.

rate.title: Rate
rate.description: Admin/Superadmin only — overrides the project's default hourly rate.

payment_rate.title: Payment Rate
payment_rate.description: Admin/Superadmin only — overrides the tasker's negotiated payment rate (%).

ProjectUpdate.title: ProjectUpdate
ProjectUpdate.description: All fields optional for partial updates.

TaskEntryCreate.title: TaskEntryCreate
TaskEntryCreate.description: Single manual task-entry request (the 'log as you go' path).

UserSelfUpdate.title: UserSelfUpdate
UserSelfUpdate.description:
Fields a user can update on their own profile via PUT /me.

Email, role, status, and payment_rate are admin-only and excluded here.

UserUpdate.title: UserUpdate
UserUpdate.description: Admin-only: all fields optional for partial updates via PUT /{id}.
